name: Carbon Black Cloud - Endpoint Standard - Alert Summary
description: The Carbon Black Cloud - Endpoint Standard - Alert Summary gives you summary of alerts in table format, provides enriched data by co-relating alerts with events metadata
title: Carbon Black Cloud - Endpoint Standard - Alert Summary

panels.title: NGAV Alerts with Rich Process Metadata

queries.queryString:
(_sourceCategory={{EventDataSource}}  or _sourceCategory={{AlertDataSource}} ) (CB_ANALYTICS or NGAV)
| join 

(json field=_raw "id", "alert_url" , "severity", "device_name","device_username", "device_target_value", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "sensor_action", "process_name", "reason", "backend_timestamp","ttps" as alert_id, alert_url ,severity ,device_name, user,target_priority, incident_id, device_os, type, sensor_action, process_name, reason, backend_timestamp,ttps nodrop //s3

| where type ="CB_ANALYTICS"
| where !(ttps matches "[]") AND !isNull(ttps)
| extract field=ttps "\"(?<indicators>.*?)\"(,|\])" multi nodrop
| count by alert_id, alert_url ,severity ,device_name, user,target_priority, incident_id, device_os, type, sensor_action, process_name, reason,indicators) 

as alert,

(json field=_raw "event_origin", "event_id", "event_description", "alert_id", "process_cmdline" as event_origin, event_id, event_description, alert_id, process_cmdline
| where event_origin="NGAV"
| count by  event_origin, event_id, event_description, alert_id, process_cmdline)

as event

on alert.alert_id = event.alert_id
| tourl (alert_alert_url, alert_alert_id) as alert_id
| count by alert_id,alert_severity, alert_device_name, alert_device_os, alert_type, alert_process_name, alert_reason, event_event_description, event_process_cmdline,alert_indicators

_sourceCategory={{AlertDataSource}}
| json field=_raw "id", "alert_url" , "severity", "device_name","device_username", "device_target_value", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "sensor_action", "process_name", "reason", "backend_timestamp","ttps" as alert_id, alert_url ,severity ,device_name, user,target_priority, incident_id, device_os, type, sensor_action, process_name, reason, backend_timestamp,ttps nodrop //s3
| where type ="CB_ANALYTICS"
| where !(ttps matches "[]") and !isNull(ttps)
| extract field=ttps "\"(?<indicators>.*?)\"(,|\])" multi nodrop
| parse regex field=process_name "(?<process_name>[^\\//]*)$"
| count by backend_timestamp,alert_id,severity,device_name, device_os, process_name,reason
